summary.name: Famxplor
summary.one_liner: Famxplor is a travel idea site that collects activities and tips for families from family travel blogs, organized by country.
keywords: things to do with kids abroad
alternative to google search for travel
use_cases: Finding activities for a family vacation in a specific country
Reading firsthand family travel blog stories before a trip
Getting tips from other parents on enjoying a destination
Deciding where to travel with young children
Saving time on family holiday research
summary.what_it_does: The site lets users select a country and read family travel blogs and activities chosen and experienced by other traveling families. It curates content only from families who travel with their children, with the stated aim of reducing the time spent searching for travel ideas. Parents also share tips on getting the most out of each visited place. The site says it aims to cover the whole world and invites users to suggest regions or blogs to add.
notable: Curates content only from families who travel with their children
Organized by country on a world map
Invites users to suggest travel blogs and regions to add
caveats: Listing is tagged as paid, but the page text does not state specific prices or tiers
